paper_metadata.title: Effects of Annealing on the Microstructure and Properties of Cold-Rolled CoCrNi Medium-Entropy Alloy

evidence.quote: CoCrNi alloy, as a prototypical FCC-structured medium-entropy alloy (MEA), has emerged as a promising candidate for advanced structural applications
